methodology: Independent cached EveryAyah Husary public recitations, deterministic synthetic noise and zero-valued silence. Native CPU recognition receives consecutive 100 ms PCM chunks without wall-clock sleeps. Completion is checked during feed, before stop and without supplying the next ayah. Timing is on the supplied audio timeline, not a live-user latency measurement. No private recording is used.

tests.name: 112:1-finishes-before-next-audio
tests.description: Automatic recognition receives only 112:1 and silence. No 112:2 audio is available; completion must arrive while listening.

tests.name: 112:1-long-pause-emits-once
tests.description: Extra silence must not turn overlapping old evidence into repeated completions.

tests.name: 112:1-midverse-clipped
tests.description: The clip stops before the final word of 112:1. A mid-ayah pause must not complete it.

tests.name: 112:1-final-word-cut-short
tests.description: The final word has not been fully supplied. A predicted ending followed by silence must not count as completion.

tests.name: 112:1-repeated-occurrences
tests.description: The same recording is recited twice in one session. Both occurrences need separate IDs; the first must complete before the second audio begins.

tests.name: 2:255-excerpt-is-not-complete
tests.description: Only the opening 12 seconds of a much longer ayah are supplied. Silence cannot finish the unspoken remainder.
